evidence.detail: The interface extends the recovered configuration contract and declares exact group key 'npcindicators' plus render-style section metadata.
Its default methods expose NPC-indicator booleans, hull/tile/outline-style controls, highlight/fill colors, border width, name/tag filtering and persisted tagged-name text.
R189 NpcIndicatorsOverlay and rs/s/o/e consume this exact interface, while R26 HighlightedNpc and R243 MemorizedNpc provide the same subsystem's entity/state models.

candidates.note: Exact-v308 RuneLite-style NPC Indicators configuration interface; the literal config group and consumer family make the noun explicit.

evidence.detail: The class extends the recovered plugin base, injects Client/config/overlay/menu services, provides NpcIndicatorsConfig, and owns plugin start/stop lifecycle methods.
Surviving literals are 'Tag', 'Un-tag', 'Tag-All' and 'Un-tag-All'; menu-hover and custom-menu paths apply those actions to NPC indicator state.
The plugin subscribes to ConfigChanged, GameStateChanged, NpcSpawned and MenuHover and manages HighlightedNpc/ MemorizedNpc state together with R189 NpcIndicatorsOverlay.
Surviving style literals include 'hull', 'tile', 'truetile', 'swtile', 'swtruetile' and 'outline', matching the configuration/overlay indicator rendering family.
